text:
amanda: Quick sync — post-launch backlog grooming in 20. Main items from support/QA: a UX bug bundle, a streaming perf regression on the hosted API, and a small feature request for rollout toggles. Need to decide hotpatch vs regular iteration.

reza: @amanda can you paste the QA bundle and rough estimate? we should prioritize by customer impact and risk.

amanda: Summary: 6 issues total — 4 UI (permission modal layout, empty-state copy, button focus, overflow on mobile), 1 routing bug (rare 502 on dedicated routing), 1 embedding mismatch (edge-case tokenization). Plus 2 enhancements: rollout toggle for Canary and improved telemetry for token breakdown. Rough: UI fixes = 1 dev-day if low-risk, routing/perf = urgent, enhancements = next sprint.

ben: If the perf regression is streaming path, that could affect many customers. I'll triage streaming traces now. Is it reproducible in staging?

lia: UX side — the UI bugs are mostly in the first-time onboarding flow; noticeable but not data-loss. I can scope a tiny design pass to make fixes low-risk.

reza: Proposal: 1) Hotpatch routing + streaming perf if it looks like a config/regression (owner: ben). 2) Bundle the 4 UI bugs into a small canary patch (owner: lia + FE) if changes are purely CSS/strings. 3) Put toggle + telemetry on next sprint backlog. Anyone object?

lia: Agree. Also include a quick a11y check for the modal change. I can do design review in ~4 hours.

ben: I'll start with traces — quick hypothesis: cache invalidation on KV layer or change in kernel selection for longer sequences. If it's config, we can hotpatch in hours; if it's kernel/model-level, that's medium risk and needs rollout gating.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for branch "ux-bugbundle-canary" at 15:30 UTC — awaiting approvals.

amanda: Plan then: (A) hotpatch routing + perf (ben) — go/no-go after triage; (B) UI canary patch for the 4 low-risk bugs (lia + FE) — run canary; (C) toggle + telemetry scheduled for next sprint. I'll update the tickets and add clear rollback steps.

reza: I'll update the roadmap board and tag tickets: hotpatch/ship, next-sprint, needs-design.

ben: Note for ops: if we do a canary, please ensure token-level logs are redacted — we don't want PII in traces. Also doc command for gated deploy: `./deploy --canary --feature-gate=ux-bundle`

lia: I'll prepare the screenshot diffs doc and a short QA checklist for regressions. @marta please run the visual regression after canary.

marta: marta: can reproduce the routing 502 locally with the supplied repro steps — will run full regression after canary completes and report back.

amanda: :thumbsup: Scheduling a 15-min huddle in 10 to confirm owners and rollback. Agenda: risk, timeline, verification, owners.

amanda: I'll drop updated ticket numbers here after the huddle. Thanks everyone.
